capability.claim: Builds a queryable knowledge graph of a codebase from local tree-sitter AST extraction, with scoped queries preferred over grepping raw files.
capability.task: Find which functions call a given function in a Python package.
capability.conditions: Local run on a Python source tree; no LLM needed for code extraction (graphify update).

comparison.comparator: Graft callers lookup over its prebuilt wiring graph (trailhq/graft, graft CLI 0.25.0).
comparison.baseline: Caller recall and precision against reviewed Python ast ground truth on identical source bytes.

target.scopeRationale: Both build a code graph and answer who-calls-this; Graphify is separately registered as safishamsi/graphify under knowledge-graph-build, so this is a cross-bucket comparison on one narrow task.

preliminaryEvidence.summary: README documents local AST extraction into a queryable graph and query-first guidance for coding assistants.
README makes no explicit claim of caller-resolution accuracy; Graphify is already registered as safishamsi/graphify under a different generic.

limitations: Five targets in one repository; not a general accuracy benchmark.
Caller sets compared at (file, bare function name) granularity; the README does not claim caller recall.
Runner session also authored the protocol; independence is declared, not authenticated.
Graphify is already registered as safishamsi/graphify under knowledge-graph-build.

independentTest.proposal: Run the fixed runner evidence/frontier-challenges/c1-graphify-vs-graft/runner/run-c1.py on the pinned revision and compare caller sets of both tools to the reviewed ast ground truth under the pre-registered decision rule in protocol.json.
independentTest.traceability: Request binds protocol, ground-truth fixture and target bytes; artifacts retain raw per-target caller sets and digests.

disposition.rationale: A narrow reproducible comparison exists and both tools are runnable locally at the pinned versions.
disposition.nextAction: Run the pre-registered protocol; Meta verification by a separate session; no admission.
